name: default
description: The standard end-to-end run: PPO league -> AZ self-play matrix -> baseline report. Phase 1 trains the ONE generalist (gen__final.zip) over the whole decks/league/ roster for 18M steps with the scripted anchor raised to 0.2, so the PPO warm-start the AZ net needs is broad rather than snapshot-inbred. Phase 2 rotates two ungated-cadence az-league passes whose self-play is the EXACT unordered deck-pair matrix played twice (exhaustive_selfplay + exhaustive_repeats 2 = 55 x 2 = 110 bo3 matches per slot on the 10-deck roster, mirrors included, entirely on the C++ actor -- build it with `make actor`) plus a rotating 20-cell slice of the ordered vs-scripted:hard pair list per slot (5 slots cover all 100 ordered pairs), expert demonstration shards for every roster deck, one-epoch training over the auto window, and a gate every 2 slots at serving strength. Phase 3 round-robins the finished generalist over every roster deck vs scripted:hard, 100 games per matchup, appended to baseline_report.log. Run the FIRST phase-1 pass with an explicit --fresh on the league command if you really mean to start the generalist over -- it is deliberately NOT baked into the plan, so a rerun/resume never wipes the generalist.
